A small bug-fix release for Windows. No license or breaking changes.

[🎧 Listen to samples](https://kanaworksai-hue.github.io/audio-studio-mcp/) · [English](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ja.md)

## Fixes

- `process_audio` with `format: "ogg"` no longer crashes the server on Windows. libsndfile's Vorbis encoder overflowed the default 1 MB Windows thread stack when a long clip was written in one call, so the process exited with `0xC00000FD` and the MCP client only saw `Connection closed`. OGG files are now written in blocks. WAV and FLAC output and macOS are not affected. Fixes #10, thanks to @elminsterii for the report, the root-cause analysis and the suggested fix.

## Update

From an existing clone:

```bash
git pull
```

Then restart your MCP client (or the server) so it loads the new version. Nothing needs to be reinstalled, and the model weights stay as they are.

New installs follow the README as before, using `--branch v0.2.2`.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
